def comb_sort(lst):
    # Initialize the two pointers
    left = 0
    right = len(lst) - 1
    # Initialize the gap
    gap = 1
    # Loop until the gap is 1
    while gap > 1:
        # Update the pointers
        left = left + gap
        right = right - gap
        # Update the gap
        gap = 1
        # Loop until the gap is 1
        while gap > 1:
            # Swap the elements
            if lst[left] > lst[right]:
                lst[left], lst[right] = lst[right], lst[left]
            # Update the pointers
            gap = gap - 1
    return lst

def largest_triangle(a,b,c):
    # calculate the semi-major and semi-minor axes
    a = a / 2
    b = b / 2
    c = c / 2

    # calculate the area of the triangle
    area = (a * b * c) / 2

    # calculate the perimeter of the triangle
    perimeter = a + b + c

    # calculate the semi-perimeter
    s = perimeter / 2

    # calculate the inradius
    inradius = area / s

    # calculate the circumradius
    circumradius = (a * b * c) / (4 * inradius)

    # calculate the largest triangle
    largest_triangle = (a * b * c) / (4 * circumradius)

    return largest_triangle

    # Iterate over the tuples
    for tup in tuples:
        # Get the current time
        current_time = tup[0]
        # Get the previous time
        previous_time = tup[1]
        # If the current time is not in the dictionary
        if current_time not in occurrences:
            # Add the current time to the dictionary
            occurrences[current_time] = 1
        # If the previous time is not in the dictionary
        elif current_time not in occurrences:
            # Add the previous time to the dictionary
            occurrences[current_time] = 1
        # If the current time is the same as the previous time
        elif current_time == previous_time:
            # Increment the number of occurrences
            occurrences[current_time] += 1
    # Return the dictionary
    return occurrences

    # Iterate over the grid
    for i in range(len(grid)):
        for j in range(len(grid[i])):
            # If the current element is not adjacent to any other element
            if i > 0 and j > 0 and grid[i-1][j-1] == 0:
                # Add the current element to the maximum sum
                max_sum += grid[i-1][j-1]
            # If the current element is adjacent to any other element
            elif i > 0 and j < n and grid[i-1][j] == 0:
                # Add the current element to the maximum sum
                max_sum += grid[i-1][j]
            # If the current element is adjacent to any other element
            elif i < n and j > 0 and grid[i][j-1] == 0:
                # Add the current element to the maximum sum
                max_sum += grid[i][j-1]
            # If the current element is adjacent to any other element
            elif i < n and j < n and grid[i][j+1] == 0:
                # Add the current element to the maximum sum
                max_sum += grid[i][j+1]
    # Return the maximum sum

        # If the character is an opening bracket

            # Push the opening bracket to the stack
            stack.append(s[i])
        # If the character is a closing bracket
        elif s[i] == ')':
            # If the stack is empty

                # Increment the swaps counter

            # Pop the opening bracket from the stack
            stack.pop()
        elif s[i] == ']':
            # If the stack is empty

                # Increment the swaps counter
                swaps += 1
            # Pop the closing bracket from the stack
            closing_brackets.append(s[i])
    # If the stack is empty
